{{Top|leg}}
A '''shock generator''', also known as a '''shock charge generator''', was a type of specialized weapon. The generator modulated electrical charges that could be used to paralyze and capture targets, as well as control crowds. Nonlethal shock generators could be fitted to [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]] such as [[Stun baton/Legends|stun batons]], [[Conner net|shock nets]], and [[Blast shield/Legends|blast shields]], as well as [[Shock collar/Legends|shock collars]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
